User.title: User
User.description: Represents a registered Job Seeker or Administrator.

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: Represents a resume uploaded/pasted by a job seeker.

contentText.description: The actual text content of the resume.

Analysis.title: Analysis
Analysis.description: Represents a comprehensive, Gemini-driven resume analysis.

userId.description: The ID of the user who requested the analysis.

overallScore.description: The calculated aggregate ATS match score out of 100.

metrics.description: JSON string containing thirty specific ATS metrics grouped into Format, Experience, Skills, and Language.

skillsGap.description: JSON string containing key missing skills identified.

keywordMatches.description: JSON string containing matched and missing keywords.

hrEvaluation.description: JSON string containing Strengths, Weaknesses, Suitability index, and Interview prep questions.

adminFeedback.description: Expert coach/HR review feedback from admin if supplied.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles locked to their respective authenticated UID.

/resumes/{resumeId}.description: Resumes owned by job seekers and protected by user visibility.
